- **File & line:** `docs/js/cart.js`, lines 61–62 (`applyPromo`)
- `applyPromo(input)` only called `input.trim()` and compared it case-sensitively (`promo.code === code`) against the uppercase promo codes in `PROMOS` (`'DINER10'`, `'PIEDAY'`), causing lowercase input `'diner10'` to be rejected.

### Root Cause
- **File & line:** `docs/js/cart.js`, lines 61–62 (`applyPromo`)
- `applyPromo(input)` only called `input.trim()` and compared it case-sensitively (`promo.code === code`) against the uppercase promo codes in `PROMOS` (`'DINER10'`, `'PIEDAY'`), causing lowercase input `'diner10'` to be rejected.

### Run Output
- **Before fix (1 run on `http://localhost:8861/`):**
  ```
  BUG_PRESENT
  Observed: error='Sorry, that code is not valid.', subtotal='$9.25', tax='$0.82', total='$10.07'
  ```
- **After fix (3 runs on `http://localhost:8861/`):**
  ```
  === Post-fix Run 1 ===
  BUG_ABSENT
  Observed: error='', subtotal='$9.25', tax='$0.74', total='$9.06'
  === Post-fix Run 2 ===

@@ -58,7 +58,7 @@ const Cart = (function () {
   }
 
   function applyPromo(input) {
-    const code = input.trim();
+    const code = input.trim().toUpperCase();
     const match = PROMOS.find((promo) => promo.code === code);
     if (!match) return false;
     state.promo = match.code;
